title: The Pink Cowgirl Halloween Costume
intro: Everyone does the brown suede cowgirl. This one keeps the dress white and lets the hot pink hat, the pink mid calf boots and the fringe phone bag do all the talking, so it reads pink from across the room. Crystal star earrings and a paisley bandana tied at the neck finish it. The corset mini and the boots are the pieces you will actually wear again, for concerts, rodeo season and every bachelorette weekend you get dragged to. Iced coffee in one hand, compliments in the other.

items.name: White square neck corset mini dress
Hot pink cowboy hat with wide belt
Hot pink fringe crossbody phone bag
